meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: Claude 会读取并展示当前挂载白名单(允许访问的目录及读写类型),也能让用户添加、删除或清空白名单条目,并把配置写入 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json。
howto.when: 当用户提到“mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“container mounts”等关键词,或要求查看/修改代理容器可访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 查一下挂载白名单里有哪些目录
say.note: 它读取并显示允许的目录和读写属性。

say.text: 把 /data 加入白名单,设为只读
say.note: 会先确认路径存在,然后写入配置。

say.text: 把 /data 从挂载白名单移除
say.note: 展示当前条目后移除并重写配置。

howto.what_en: Claude can read and display the current mount allowlist (allowed host directories and whether each is read-only or read-write), and can add, remove, or reset entries by rewriting ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like "mounts", "mount allowlist", or "container mounts", or asks to view/change which directories agent containers can access.

say_en.text: List the mounts in the allowlist
say_en.note: Reads and displays allowed directories with read/write type.

say_en.text: Add /data to the allowlist as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path, then writes the config.
Shows current entries, then removes and rewrites config.
